report_sql.sql_query: SELECT * FROM mamba_view_fact_insurance_report WHERE insurance_id = insurance_identifier AND admission_date BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
SELECT * FROM mamba_view_fact_consommation_report WHERE insurancename = company AND date BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
SELECT * FROM mamba_view_fact_thirdparty_report WHERE third_party_name = third_party_name AND third_party_created_date BETWEEN start_date AND end_date

SELECT refund_id, CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN payment_id ELSE NULL END AS payment_id, CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN cashier_name ELSE NULL END AS cashier_name, CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN submitted_on ELSE NULL END AS submitted_on, CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN approvedby ELSE NULL END AS approvedby, CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN confirmed_by ELSE NULL END AS confirmed_by, service_name, qty_paid, refund_qty, unit_price, refund_reason FROM (SELECT * FROM mamba_view_fact_paymentrefunds_report WHERE cashier_name = collector AND submitted_on BETWEEN start_date AND end_date) AS refund_data ORDER BY refund_id, rn
SELECT * FROM mamba_view_fact_deposits_report WHERE date BETWEEN start_date AND end_date AND reason = type OR collector = collector
SELECT insurance_id, mamba_dim_insurance.current_insurance_rate, mamba_dim_insurance.current_insurance_rate_flat_fee, category, name FROM mamba_dim_insurance
SELECT third_party_id, name, rate, created_date, voided FROM mamba_dim_third_party;
